Wounds from Metal Blades
Various Wounds

Examine the patient to determine whether the wound is shallow or deep; each case has its prognosis for life or death. If the intestine protrudes once, it is the large intestine — observe it daily. First, do not allow the intestine to become necrotic; treat accordingly to allow the intestine to heal.

If there is abdominal pain and shortness of breath, and the patient cannot eat or drink, death is likely. If the intestine protrudes, remove it the same day; trim away necrotic tissue and treat the intestine to allow healing.

Suture as by the standard method, then return the intestine inside. If the intestine is in two segments and hard to see, smear blood on it to reconnect the parts continuously. Use large grains of barley to measure; remove necrotic portions and treat the intestine so it heals.

Using half the method, after suturing, wash and clean the wound. If the patient cannot drink, use barley to measure, remove necrotic portions and treat the intestine so it heals.

Gradually push the intestine in and return it inside. If the intestine is in two segments and can be seen, smear blood on it and reconnect it continuously. Use two large barley grains to measure; remove and trim necrotic tissue and treat the intestine to allow healing.

After soaking, then allow the patient to gradually take in fluids. For metal blade wounds where much blood is lost: stop the bleeding; the patient must not speak at length or laugh.

Do not engage in movement or exertion — movement leads to death. Salty and sour foods and alcohol are prohibited. Also, use hemostatics. The patient must not speak at length, shout, or laugh.

Conditions that are difficult to treat or untreatable: If the wound from a metal blade penetrates into the lung, or if the intestine is totally severed — death is inevitable. Of seven such patients, only two may survive.

Untreatable Conditions:
Difficult to treat; left-side intestinal wounds penetrating inward — total intestinal severance results in immediate death; of two cases, perhaps one in seven may survive.

Pulse Indicators for Metal Wounds (Sword/Weapon Injuries)

In medicine, when the pulse is completely deficient and not full (shi), the condition is untreatable. If the lower abdomen is injured and the yang interior is damaged, this is also untreatable. When wounds are numerous and extensive, treatment is also not feasible.

When medication is given, if the pulse has completely dissipated, treatment may still be possible. In elderly patients, wounds penetrating from the shoulder area through to the interior are critical. Injuries that have penetrated deeply inward to the spine and the interior of the bowels are also very serious.

When a wound causes bleeding and the pulse is deep and small, but a large pulse indicates survival. A rapid and full pulse in one who has been stabbed and is bleeding indicates death.

When a wound causes excessive blood loss, a vacuous, fine, or large pulse indicates survival. A rapid, full pulse in a stabbed patient who is bleeding indicates death.

When a small wound becomes infected and the pulse is fine, if it then becomes large, death occurs within seven days. Superficial wounds are difficult to heal. When the pulse of a metal wound is such that blood can still flow out, there is hope.

When a serious wound causes the pulse to become large, unresponsive and without equilibrium, and if blood continues to pour out, the pulse condition indicates that the patient may still bleed further.

For wounds where the pulse cannot be broken — when there is flooding and harmonizing — if the intestines protrude outside the abdomen, the entire bowel must be carefully sutured back; this is extremely difficult for a physician. If it is severed, suturing may not be possible.

Treatment Method for Intestinal and Abdominal Injuries

Apply fat and ointment. If the skin remains intact, clean the area with oil and apply medicinal herbs such as mugwort. Wait until living tissue adheres. Stop bleeding and dissolve putrefaction. Then apply the herbal powder and administer internal medicine.

If the intestines and abdomen have both prolapsed, use herbal decoctions and wait for the tissue to become viable, then cover with prepared stone (mineral preparation), suture the abdomen — but do not suture the peritoneum to the external intestines. Administer internal medicine.

Gold Wound (Jinchang) Treatment: First, one should regulate the blood. If there is much stasis, nourish and break up stagnant blood, and relieve pain as the primary aim. Use Fuyuan Huoxue Decoction, Yiyuan Powder, Huarui Stone Powder — choose and apply as appropriate. In difficult cases, disperse the blood stasis. If there is accumulated stasis, first draw out the wound and remove the diseased blood from within. If there is blood accumulation, there will necessarily be constipation and stagnation; one must promote free flow and not allow the two orifices to become obstructed. After this, regulate the intestines.

Medicines for Stopping Bleeding, Generating Flesh, and Closing Wounds: If bleeding is excessive, collect the blood [stop it], apply powder to the mouth of the wound. White resin (baijiaoXiang) is especially effective. Old yellow minium (huangdan), bark decoctions, wash with white water, apply yunshi powder mixed with blood powder. In summer months, apply thinly laid over single cloth to keep flies away. Apply white yunshi powder mixed and fixed, white salt compressed into pieces — select and use as the sound [condition] dictates.

Arrows, Arrowheads, and Blades Lodged in Bones and Vessels That Will Not Come Out: After twenty days they will emerge on their own. Iron clam extract; also mouse brain applied externally; also elephant [brain]; also fine phoenix [feather]; mixed one part, half of white money (money equivalent), Banxia (Pinellia) in equal parts, ground and taken orally as powder, three doses each time until [it comes out]. Apply fire to draw it; with this method use iron smoke ash mixed and applied to the eyes — all cases have [resolved]. In one instance, a person alone in a room cut and ground [it]; when the strength was insufficient and the wound not yet healed with the metal fragment still lodged, the powder was taken, and eventually after a long time cutting it came out again.

Use the hand to lift away the plaster and bandage. There is no harm in also taking medicine — this is the Open-Pass medicine. Do not allow the two orifices (bowels and bladder) to become obstructed. Thereafter regulate the intestines.

Insert internally and sew with thread; continue taking free-flow-promoting medicine; remove [the stitches]; thereafter regulate the intestines.

Disperse stagnant blood and relieve pain as the primary aim: Fuyuan Huoxue Decoction, Yiyuan Powder, Huarui Stone Powder.

Emergency Remedies (救急方)

[Top section - general indications:]
For gold-edge wounds (sword/knife wounds) and various serious injuries with pain and distress in the abdomen; for battle wounds of extreme severity where the person loses consciousness.

Take vinegar decoction, mix and drink it; the blood inside the abdomen will come out and the patient will recover. Also for those severely wounded in battle who have lost consciousness: use boy's urine, drink while still warm; this will cause the blood to come out and the patient will recover. Even those on the verge of death may revive.

Huoxue San (活血散 - Blood-Activating Powder)

For knife wounds causing the abdomen to split open with the intestines protruding. Ingredients: Danggui (Angelica sinensis), Chuanxiong (Ligusticum chuanxiong), Baizhi (Angelica dahurica), each equal parts. For every three qian, take warm with wine. This formula has been proven effective for all knife and sword wounds, as well as injuries from falls and strikes.

Huayao Shi San (花藥石散 - Flower Medicine Stone Powder)

Take four liang of huayao stone, crush it finely, heat it with charcoal fire, roast overnight, let cool, collect the dried medicine. Grind finely and for each dose take one da (large measure), add to wine, decoct and simmer, mix well and drink.

This medicine is used when injuries from knife wounds, falls, and blows cause blood to accumulate internally. If the blood has become lodged in the organs causing pain, swelling, and blockage, this medicine will dissolve and transform the stagnant blood internally. Those who are on the verge of death from severe injury should take this medicine urgently; thereafter the situation will improve.

Duoming San (Life-Saving Powder)
Treats wounds from metal blades and knives, cuts, falls from heights into water, injuries from stones and lime; used for stagnant blood and bruising.
Mix with wine. Ingredients include rhubarb (Dahuang), black morning glory seed (Qianniu), for abdominal pain and inability to urinate or defecate; use lime stir-fried until charred for blood stasis.
Treats cases where morning glory seed is used when there is no blunt trauma injury; each ingredient: two liang of lime, stir-fried twice until done, strain through silk.
Five qian of gold, stir-fried three times, with Chinese angelica tail for bleeding injuries; two liang research dose, rhubarb on the right, one qian cut.

Jimyeong San (Rooster-Crow Powder)
Treats [injuries]: apply one plaster immediately to disperse; apply five qian gold, stir-fried, with Chinese angelica; at the appropriate time take orally; three days: peach kernels, twenty-seven pieces, grind and cut.

Cong Zhi San (Scallion Stagnation Powder)
Decoct with wine, adjust dosage; treats traumatic injuries; Chinese angelica internally; for fractures at the appropriate time, take for three days; peach kernels, twenty-seven pieces, grind; cut on right.
Two and a half large portions, hemp, small amount; grind to powder, each dose three parts rhubarb.

Poxue Xiaotong Tang (Blood-Breaking Pain-Relieving Decoction)
Take with wine; treats traumatic injuries, falls, stagnant blood flowing and lodging in the chest and flanks causing pain and inability to move.
Increase steel-peony, small amounts each; when condition changes, water stir-fry until smoke is gone, blood also ground, three portions; lower chest pain, bupleurum, unable to move.
Water stir-fried, on empty stomach, remove, enter carp, stir-fry fragrant; combine with ligusticum, saposhnikovia, cinnamon bark, each plaster one.
Adjust and take peony, ligusticum, remove from decoction, draw and cut once.

Fuyuan Huoxue Tang (Origin-Restoring Blood-Activating Decoction)
Bupleurum one, same, half; pangolin scales two and a half qian, stir-fried and ground; trichosanthes root, ginger one root, seven fen, bupleurum.
Stir-fried rhubarb two qian; large rhubarb two qian; [ingredients] adhere, recover;霞 two and a half qian; Chinese angelica one qian seven fen; licorice, bupleurum.

[Right side column:] One qian of peach kernel (ten pieces ground to paste), red flower five fen, applied with a mixture of wine and water, decocted and taken in the morning. Have four people each go out in the four directions.

Gold-Wound Powder (Jin Shang San):
Take the same amount of tangerine branch herb, each half a jin. On a certain day at the hour of Chen (morning), add one jin of lime, using mulberry bark to fill and seal it.

Place it with the bark, olive oil, and large mulberry leaves, densely packed, three liang, allow it to form a hole for inserting the medicine, using a treasure basket with mulberry bark to fill.

Seal it on the ninth day of the ninth lunar month. If the noon hour is encountered, take it out and dry it in the shade until effective. Seal again with mulberry bark.

Simple Remedies [Dan Fang]: 49 varieties, 20 [entries]

Fresh-drawn water: For metal wounds causing the body to be bound and yang to come out on its own — use fresh-drawn water. For sword wounds, mix with egg white and powdered lime, wrap and apply.

Lime:
Effective for treating and immediately stopping bleeding and masses; extremely good for the spirit. Also, for metal blade wounds, mix with egg and white ash maggots and apply.

Kudzu root (Ge Gen):
Also treats carbuncles and abscesses; extract the juice, dry into powder, and apply.

Mulberry white bark (Sang Bai Pi):
Can be boiled into glue to relieve pain; for eye surgery, use this bark as thread to suture the abdomen in cases of intestinal prolapse. Excellent. A marvelous medicine of immortals for knife and arrow wounds.

Oyster (蠣蛄)
Mulberry leaves ground into powder and applied dry cannot be spoken of as gold [i.e., it is invaluable]. To stop pain, apply mulberry wood ash. For an arrowhead lodged in the throat that will not come out: take the juice from the oyster's diaphragm and drip it on — within three to five [applications] one will feel relief. If the arrowhead remains in the flesh and will not come out, combine the oyster diaphragm with sulfur, grind together, and apply. For blood impediment (血痺) caused by an arrowhead lodged in the bone that cannot be conveniently extracted: heat it slightly with the herb, then apply a plaster made by grinding together oyster and baodou (croton seed), and coat the area.

Ant (螞蟻)
For wounds from arrowheads that have entered the bone causing impediment and cannot be extracted: use a formula with ant heads ground into powder; the drug will draw out itching from within, emanating fragrance; apply a muscle-regenerating plaster to coat.
Same method is used to expel it.

Wild Wormwood Root (旋蒿根)
Mainly used with water to apply to arrowheads; also using wild wormwood flowers, drip onto [the wound] to dry up the site, quench the metal [arrowhead], relieve itching, and draw out the sinew dry. Take as directed.

Ivory (象牙)
Administer in water orally daily until the flesh and bone are fully saturated; where the tooth cannot resist, take the top portion, roast and grind into fine powder, mix with bone, take the upper portion as a compress, dissolve one qian (measure) and mix.

Bat (蝙蝠)
Mainly used with water for metal arrowheads that have entered the flesh and are not fully removed: take the upper portion as a compress, which will dissolve blood — mix one qian.

Black Wind Herb (黑風)
Also used for people with head and dental pain: grind together, apply, and stop [pain]; take immediately, the upper portion will disperse like black milk — mix one qian.

Scallion (蔥)
Immediately stop bleeding from metal wounds: because metal injures the teeth causing swelling and pain together with bleeding, take scallion leaves, cook until soft, grind into a paste, apply — the bleeding will stop immediately and recovery follows.

Wheat (小麥):
It governs intestinal discharge. Take it so that it does not enter [the wrong passage]. Have the person hold wheat in the mouth and chew it. Use five sheng of wheat with nine sheng of water, boil down to four sheng, remove the dregs. It makes people extremely [calm/nourished]. [Reference to Zheng Zhong and others.]

Pomegranate Flower (石榴花):
Treat [bleeding]: pound lime and pomegranate [flower] into a powder; for flowing blood that does not stop and for tooth decay. The juice governs [conditions involving] dark [blood], carbuncles and ulcers; for blood that does not stop, take pomegranate flower and mix [with other ingredients].

Wall Spider / Cobweb (壁錢):
The juice governs carbuncles and ulcers; for blood that does not stop. Apply it to the corners of the mouth and the dark recesses of various yin areas.

Mouse Brain and Liver (鼠腦肝):
For treating [sores]; take the mouse brain and liver, pound and apply. Apply to the corners of the mouth and the dark recesses; [the pathogen] will immediately come out.

Purple Sandalwood (紫檀香):
Treats carbuncles, stops bleeding and pain; scrape purple sandalwood into powder and apply. Stops acute bleeding; though it cannot be used in large quantities, it is wonderfully effective on muscle tissue.

Dragon's Blood Resin (血蝎):
Treats and stops [bleeding from] metal wounds and carbuncles. Stops acute bleeding; cannot be used in large quantities; wonderfully effective when scraped and applied.

Amber (琥珀):
Governs closure [of wounds], rejoins severed muscle, closes metal [knife] wounds; applying it is excellent. Use one coin's weight of the powder with boy's urine, adjust and take orally — remarkably effective.

Snake-holding Herb (蛇含草):
Snake-containing paste connects and heals decayed [damaged] fingers. Governs metal wounds, carbuncles and ulcers; applying it to the flesh is excellent.

Qing Wan (Green Myriad)

Mugwort (Zhu Ai): Salt-processed. Stops pain. Raw — apply to skin and muscles; decocted — apply to sores, or use to steam; also good for combining.

Small Thistle (Xiao Ji): Collect and press the juice. Apply to gold [weapon] wounds; stops bleeding.

Indigo Leaf Juice (Lan Ye Zhi): Apply to sores; drink the blood [i.e., the juice pressed from it]; relieves swelling.

Placenta (Che Tai/Che Pao): Use eight portions within the salt solution; take two daily; after nine [days] change; take five turns; the sediment rises to the top, rest with eyes open, first open the area, roll with the sleeve, wrap its mouth, drink it warm with a small amount.

Catch, Press, Fall, Crush, and Collapse Injuries (Lan Cuo Duo Luo Ya Dao Shang):

If a person suddenly loses consciousness, first open the mouth, insert into the nose to check for breath. If breath has stopped, urgently open the mouth, press and beat to revive. Once the person's warmth returns, control the temperature with hot liquid, pour repeatedly; use fragrant oil, half a spoonful of powder, pour it in.

If the person feels pressure crushing the heart, heat the area, pour warm liquid into the small opening repeatedly, accumulate by layers; if needed remove with Sumu (sappanwood) to revive early.

Then if sinews and bones enter into the skin, abdomen, and flesh, attacking the heart with blood — if the pain does not stop, or if there is a fall or strike injury with stagnant accumulation — one must remove [the obstruction] with Sumu to revive early.

Blood and bile: Huanglian (Coptis) reduces fire. Atractylodes combined with boy's urine, for injuries from falling from a height — if the injury is in the upper body, one should take it decocted, which is wonderfully effective for fright and shock from injury.

For injuries combined with the five viscera: there are necessarily nine categories of contusion. For internal pressure injuries, or when decocting from urine — for injuries in the upper body it is appropriate to use [this].

For injuries to the heart with deficiency: the lower [method] should be used; Huotong Decoction with nine [pills], for damage and blood loss, specifically discussing the liver governing blood — first use without questioning what location; attack with medicine.

For clam-blood dispersing powder: if taken in large doses but then vomiting of blood occurs and the dispersing does not stop, this is difficult to treat; it is appropriate to use frankincense and Perilla.

For Combined Fragrance Powder with paired Yuan [pills], treating pain from blows and fractures; the various elixirs supplement blood for injuries; those difficult to treat should use frankincense and Perilla.

For urgent injuries: if jade [bones] are broken, warm wine adjusted with urine should be poured in, whereupon the qi will turn and blood will gradually stabilize as normal.

Tongdao Powder: Treats trauma with extreme blood stasis, severe fractures, urinary blockage, and abdominal distension and stuffiness — this formula is appropriate to use.

For each ingredient below: Rhubarb [Da Huang] — large dose; broken [pieces] — for urinary blockage and abdominal distension and fullness, this formula is appropriate.

Composition: Each one qian of Houpo (Magnolia bark), Chenpi (tangerine peel), Mutong (Akebia), Zhike (bitter orange), Gancao (licorice), each half a qian; Danggui (Angelica), Sumu (Sappan wood), Honghua (safflower), Taoren (peach kernel). [Take to the] right [side for preparation].

Danggwisu-san (Powder of Angelica Root Fibers)
Treats injuries from blows and falls, stagnation of qi, congealing of blood, abdominal distension and pain. Angelica root 1 qian, [for] contusion injuries 7 fen, cinnamon bark (dry-fried) 100 [parts], harmonize with frost [processed ingredient], take equal portions each. Red [ingredient] ground, prepared, [for] vomiting blood, water portion, mutually take; Glycyrrhiza (licorice), Sumu (sappan wood), each return to one.

Zhashuang-san (Frost Powder)
5 fen, right [side instructions]: treat injuries, [process] for large [dosage], vomit [expel], wine, water portion, mutually take; Glycyrrhiza, Sumu, equal portions, one.

Ruxiang Dingtong-san (Frankincense Pain-Relieving Powder)
Right [side instructions]: for each 1–2 qian, warm wine and boy's urine, half each, adjust with white [processed] Angelica, Sumu, raw Glycyrrhiza, Moutan bark, each equal portions.

Ruxiang-san (Frankincense Powder)
Portion, right [side]: decoct to powder, each time 1–2 qian, warm wine, [if] pain does not stop, boy's urine half, adjust; Frankincense, Myrrh, Ligusticum, Dried Ginger, Angelica, Sumu, Glycyrrhiza, equal portions, Atractylodes (dry-fried), Angelica (dry-fried), white [ingredient].

Shuangwu-san (Double Aconite Powder)
Warm wine to blend; treats injuries, various conditions below, all types of received and subsequent chronic pain, as well as fresh new injuries.
Sumu, Rhubarb (blast-fried), raw Sichuan Aconite,草烏 (wild aconite, lightly blast-fried), each 3 qian, Angelica, White Peony, [other] medicines prepared.
The reason for dry-frying the aconites is to avoid too fierce [action]; dried Rehmannia, Red Leaven (dry-fried); if one feels numbness and paralysis, [add] Aquilaria fragrance, a little, Licorice, right [side].

Xun Tong Yuan (Pain-Seeking Pill)
Treats all kinds of pain; stops pain, calms the heart, moves qi, activates blood, with miraculous effect. Ingredients include herbs such as black soybean, fresh ginger, and aromatic herbs. Grind into powder, mix with fire wine (alcohol), form into pills, dissolve and take. Use cinnabar three qian.
Treat: grind into fine powder, take with peppermint decoction. Pills like chrysanthemum. Juice ground with one liang; quicklime six liang.
Stir-fry together until purple; stops bleeding and relieves pain. Rhubarb one liang, ground into powder, applied to the injured area. Effective.

Chen Wang Dan (Chen Wang Elixir)
Grind into powder. Treats various fractures. When the color turns purple, it stops bleeding and relieves pain. Rhubarb one liang, quicklime six liang, effective.
When color reaches purple, remove the fire toxin. Rhubarb juice one liang, ground into powder, applied to the injured area.

Bu Sun Dang Gui San (Injury-Supplementing Angelica Powder)
Treats falls and injuries, bruised sinews and fractures, pain with swelling, eye symptoms; this formula is highly effective.
Pepper half, angelica root, dried ginger powder, each two to seven parts, warm wine, aconite, orchid, each half, cinnamon heart, ligusticum.

Treating Swelling and Scarring from Blows and Falls
For external use: immediately reduces swelling. Almond kernel, nine pellets; hot, broken, suppurated, disordered; apply to cheeks and swollen face, over the eyes, to draw out.
Reduces swelling immediately. Apply to hot suppuration, mix with thin gruel, for new bleeding and bruising, apply to wounds and sores, combining the ingredients.

Stop swelling; boil together, the powder disperses, apply to the back. Combine with water, heat over fire, apply topically. Rhubarb, indigo, mixed; grind for eyes; take orally; mix with ginger juice; stir and blend; apply to affected area; combine and name.
Stop swelling immediately; use almond kernel; mix with thin gruel; apply to new wounds and bruises; combine; boil; for night pain.

The next day, use medicinal wine to adjust; if there is no money for medicine, take one large piece cut into slices. For burns on the skin causing green swelling.

Pulse Indicators and Signs of Untreatable Conditions

In wealthy patients with deficiency, if the pulse is thin and weak in a small person, when one palpates a traumatic injury and finds internal blood stasis, the pulse will be firm and strong with excessive bleeding — this indicates a survivable condition.

When treating bone deficiency, hidden diseases in the organs and membranes, as well as fatal perforating wounds, bleeding wounds, if blood loss is excessive and the pulse becomes sunken — these indicate dangerous conditions in the chest cavities and organs.

Fatal wound locations — observe these points: if the pulse is deficient and in critical condition, as with arrow wounds to the organs.

Single Remedies (Seven to Nine Types, Ten Items):

Cattail pollen (Pú Huáng): Treats traumatic bruising and blood stagnation. Take in wine internally for unbearable pain and stiffness.

White poplar bark (Bái Yáng Shù Pí): Treats bruising and bleeding under the skin. Taking it relieves irritability and tightness.

Live turtle: Treats bruising of the flesh. Grind and scrape out the blood, mix and apply to the pulse region below. Effective; drink the broth.

Toad: Extract its juice, mix with wine and drink. Also grind and apply to areas of swelling and pain below the abdomen. Effective for fullness and pain.

RAT DROPPINGS
Treats injuries to the muscles and bones from disrupted circulation when the pain is unbearable. Take the droppings, burn them into a powder, and take with children's urine.

LOTUS LEAF
Promotes urination. Grind into powder and mix with liquid, take orally. For two qian per dose, three times daily. For blood attacking the heart, within half a day recovery will come — grind the leaf into powder and take with children's urine.

WALNUT
For blunt trauma injuries, pound the walnut meat into a mash and apply; after a time the pain will subside.

HEMP ROOT
Take the juice and drink it, or boil and take as a decoction. For fractures with internal bleeding where the pain is unbearable, take the roots and leaves, boil, and drink the juice.

RICE STRAW ASH
For treating deep wounds and bruises, collect the ash, mix it into a paste and apply to the wound. Combine with kindling, apply to the painful area; urine difference noted. (Reference: Han)

MUSTARD SEED
Grind a small amount and apply it as a plaster over the blood and injury site, as a warm compress over the painful area. When the patient can no longer endure the pain, take mustard mixed with fresh material, steam it, and apply. Relief will follow.

GREEN ONION (SCALLION) WHITE
For pain and fixed swelling after a blow, apply the mashed white part of the scallion directly to the injured and painful area. When the patient cannot bear it, take the scallion, place it in the wound area; if raw, it can easily be heated — those who use heat and warmth should apply it more thoroughly until well done.

HUMAN URINE
Drink one to two sheng in a single dose; this immediately revives and moves blood that has attacked the heart and caused collapse with heat. (Reference: Han) For pain, apply as directed. Also: scallion white and sugar in equal parts, pounded thoroughly and placed in — if raw, it can be easily heated; those who use warmth should apply more until thoroughly heated.

Black Hen (Crow Chicken)

Black hen: [Used when someone is] crushed, suffocated, or injured in boats, ships, carriages, horse-drawn vehicles, or trampled by cattle; for broken bones, abdominal injuries, fractured limbs.
[Preparation/treatment notes]: Use wine, one measure — dispels stagnant qi and stuffiness. One sheng (升) helps dispel cold, draws out from the muscles, causes vomiting of the new [harmful substance], cannot be removed — apply medicine, apply cloth on top, roll up, set, dry; the spirit dries, hence [recovery].

Crow Feathers

Treats falling injuries, contusion damage, blood stasis, distension of the heart and face, blue complexion, shortness of breath. Take [the feather], burn and extract the blood [substance].

Dog Bile

Also treats all [injuries from] falls, strikes, swords, and arrows. Dog urine [and bile]: burn to preserve nature [of the substance], grind to powder, heat in wine, take orally — three doses of blood [medicine].

Wine Lees

Primarily [treats] injuries from beatings and blows; fermented, steamed, warm — disperses stasis and promotes healing of blood. Mix with water, stir-fry earthworm, grind to powder for blood [conditions].

Earthworm

Enters [the body as] main [medicine]: for epilepsy — [use] a small amount; for hemiplegia — internal [use], warm; when there is [stasis], mix in wine and take orally to drain downward; treats blood [stasis]. Stir-fry earthworm until charred, grind to powder for blood [conditions].
Also [use] one section from the junction of four fists' distance from the root of the mother [earthworm], where three intersections are found.

Bone Fractures and Joint Dislocations

[Various treatment instructions for fractures involving] mutual [alignment of bones], coins [as measurement], taken from the white [bone], nine [finger-breadths down], hand/foot; also six [positions] taken from the white, four fists' [distance], grasping the root of the mother, where three intersections meet.
Inside, if [the bone] comes out white, use three [methods] to insert into the kidney interior, outside the root. If it comes out internally, one must manipulate and turn the bone.

[This page from the Dongui Bogam, Herbal Medicine volume, describes methods for treating bone injuries, fractures, and dislocations. The following is a translation of the readable portions:]

Pain entering from outside — method for when [the condition] has entered the interior of the body. When [the bone] must be returned to its original position, one must first store the medicine, keep the limb bent or straight as appropriate, and not strike or jostle it. Then use it once [as directed].

For fractures entering the cold [regions of the body], there are [conditions occurring at] the eighteenth or nineteenth [stage], requiring [special treatment].

When on one side the border has become bent and not straight, or if a knife is used to cut and open [the area], or if powder is used to wash the bone, bone clamps and bone fragments — for those whose bones are fragmented, one must keep them bent and straight, and must not strike or jostle them. Use Blood-Activating Powder (活血散) and Bone-Joining Powder (接骨散) and Bone-Joining Pills (接骨丹).

For bones that have flipped upward over one or two days, for finely fragmented bones: use scissors to trim away the fragmented bone, remove the flesh, use bone forceps to clamp and fix the bone. Then apply the Bone-Joining Method externally. Use Achyranthes Grove Powder (牛膝林散) method. Afterwards use Vitex Scatter (夏荊散), then use Bone-Joining Powder and Bone-Joining Pills to reconnect the bone.

Caowu Powder (草烏散):
For bone realignment and sudden reduction — the medicinal herb itself. For connecting bones: use Nine Bone Clamps to fix the bone. Purple Gold Pellet (紫金丹), [applied to] the skin. This medicine connects bones and pastes Purple Inner Gold Pellet inside; externally apply Achyranthes Grove Powder method. Use Bone Powder Pills (骨散丹) to join the bones.

[Preparation method for a formula using] two portions of Chuanzi (川苧), half portion of Egret Horn (鷺角), two qian (錢), smelted and refined into half portion of Gypsum (石膏), white — this medicine joins bones and forms a paste.

Method for Extracting Bamboo Sap (Zhuili):

Place one or two upright bamboo pieces against a wall; arrange two large bamboo stalks, each two chi long; split each piece into two halves; set up two pieces; immerse them; place over a well with water coming out at the top; bind the ends with cotton to prevent moisture and souring.
Freeze the damaged area; use sand below; apply fire all over; let the bamboo sap flow; both ends sink into a vessel to collect; prevent moisture; seal with cotton.
Apply heat on both ends; collect; use fire all over; let water sink into a vessel; collect and prevent moisture; seal with cotton.
Place in warm sand; collect; apply fire during summer months; let water sink into vessel; prevent moisture; seal with cotton.

Method for Making Red Distilled Liquor (Hongshao Wine):

Wait a while; take the color bright red and pleasing; among the herbs, use purple herb (zicao); five qian or seven qian; finely cut and place into the vat.
One portion of liquor; permeate; distill; first take purple herb (zicao); five qian or seven qian; finely cut and place into the vat.

Method to Stop a Child from Crying in Difficult Situations
Gently warm over medium heat and stir together. When the child will not stop crying despite efforts, place a piece of licorice root (gancao) boiled in decoction — or any sweet substance — in the child's mouth. This stops the crying.
I have used this method to save people. When the child's crying is heard by no one nearby, do not neglect to apply this; knowing this method, one may calm the child quickly using any sweet food substance.
